purpose: Targeted remediation validation: proves the two concrete Batch-1 (production_batch_001_v1) failure classes - business-category readable-text leakage and device-lid brand-logo leakage - are fixed before Batch 2 is considered. Reuses actual Batch-1 offender IDs (from tools/card_art/output/production_batch_001_v1/qa_layer2_human_review_v1.json) wherever possible rather than picking easy clean cards. Not a D4 redesign, not a model change, not fal.ai, not Batch 2.

strengthened global_brand_safety_policy device-lid/logo language (laptops, tablets, phones, monitors)
strengthened global_brand_safety_policy software-icon and financial-index-term language

avoided: no unrelated successful Batch-1 images are being regenerated - all 12 ids here were confirmed defective in production_batch_001_v1/qa_layer2_human_review_v1.json (or, for the 2 arts controls, chosen as the most severe text leaks outside the business category)

expected.note: Uses the real production compiler (global_style_v1.json now includes business_text_suppression_policy + strengthened global_brand_safety_policy; hobby_overrides_v1.json unchanged for these 12 ids).

decision_rule.green: The specific Batch-1 blockers (business readable text, device-lid logos) are fixed; Batch 2 may be considered (still requires new explicit user authorization).
